Collateral monitor

Positions refresh every block from the indexer.

Ratios below the threshold move into the liquidation queue.

The queue settles in order of arrival, oldest first.

Keepers earn the spread between the oracle and the auction.

Each settlement links to its transaction on the explorer.

Simulated positions carry a label and an as-of time.

Ratios use the median of three oracle feeds.

Auctions start at the oracle price and step down each block.

Every keeper action is signed and logged.

The vault never lends more than its buffer allows.
